prompt: Generate a high fidelity desktop web app UI mockup for Climbing Club Dashboard, landscape, edge-to-edge screen without device or browser surround. The club treasurer works offline collecting gas receipts, reviewing extracted total cost and price per gallon, then exporting a printable reimbursement PDF. Dark theme with midnight navy shell, slate working surfaces, legible white and muted blue-gray text, exact brand accent #4B9CD3 on selections and primary actions; dark ink text on blue buttons. Clean humanist sans typography, precise tabular currency, no decorative charts or climbing artwork. Standard familiar app controls. Example data is explicitly labeled Illustrative trip. Example trip: Fall climbing trip, Oct 30–Nov 1 2026, New River Gorge; 3 drivers. Alex Morgan has gas receipt 1 $42.50 at $3.459/gal and receipt 2 $38.25 at $3.399/gal, subtotal $80.75, Zelle. Other drivers Jamie Chen $56.20 CashApp, Sam Rivera $49.10 Check. One receipt needs review. Header includes trip name, dates and location; navigation Trips, Profile, Storage. Each receipt belongs to a driver. PDF has no images. No invented official club branding. PDF-first composition: slim left app navigation, trip header, two major work areas: narrower driver-and-receipt editor on left, large white printable PDF page on right inside dark preview canvas. PDF titled Trip receipt, receipt no. 20261030-01, trip details, organization block placeholders labeled Complete in Profile (do not invent bank details), per-driver receipt lines, subtotals, Zelle/CashApp/Check and cursive names. No original receipt photos in PDF. PDF preview shows missing profile warning above and Export PDF action. Signature names are labeled generated names in app editor. White PDF page is realistic readable print layout inside dark app, not a second app theme.
